一名男子走过费城市政厅漫长而阴森的走廊。他抬头看着悬挂在房间外的一块块小标牌。

显然，他是市政厅里的陌生人。他看起来不像政客、市政府雇员、律师的跑腿，也不像聚集在那里的任何特定的“闲杂人等”。另一名男子走上前去，询问是否需要帮助。这第二个人显然属于这里的人。你总是能从他们的穿着和举止中分辨出来。

陌生人说明了他的来意。他想开展一项新业务。两人交谈起来。第三个人，也是市政厅的人，加入了他们。他认识那第二个人。

随后，第二个人借口离开，消失在从主走廊延伸出去的一条昏暗、 obscure 的小巷里。他迅速走进一个房间——一个摆满了一排排小照片的房间。众所周知，这就是“罪犯照片陈列室”（rogues gallery）。找到他要找的那张照片后，他审视了片刻，然后沿着黑暗小巷深处的一段楼梯疾步而上，来到楼上两层的另一个房间。

十五分钟后，他回到走廊，那两个人还在那里谈话。他的同伴迅速对陌生人开口说话。

“您是在找许可证部门吗？”他问道，仿佛刚刚想起陌生人的来意。“嗯，就在南走廊那边——568室。您能找到。”陌生人便离开了。

“行了，是吧？”一名侦探对另一名侦探说。

“是的，十分钟内就收到了来自罗克维尤监狱（Rockview Penitentiary）的回信，说他已服满刑期，”那位离开让两人继续谈话的侦探说。“州警也回复说没问题。”

宾夕法尼亚州贝尔方特（Bellefonte）的西部监狱距离费城250英里，而哈里斯堡（Harrisburg）的州警察总部大约在100英里之外。虽然这位“陌生人”对此一无所知，但关于他的信息已被传送，因为警方对他非常熟悉。

.........曾在罗克维尤服刑者现位于费城市政厅 他是否被罗克维尤或州警察通缉 侦探正在此处与其交谈 未逮捕 请尽快告知我们

这条信息通过去年十二月为宾夕法尼亚州警察安装的新式电话打字机通信系统发送出去。在哈里斯堡，信息被转接到监狱。几分钟后，“陌生人”的档案被查清无误。随后打字回复。当信息在费城市政厅被接收的同时，侦探站在那里阅读了回复。然后他下楼

“如果没有我们的新式电话打字机系统，”费城警察局电话交换台的首席调度员詹姆斯·J·多尔蒂（James J. Dougherty）说，“那种工作可能需要两天时间”。

在整个宾夕法尼亚州多山林立的地区——这片土地为罪犯提供了极佳的藏身之处，他们可以沿着偏僻的道路向任何方向飞速行驶以逃脱法律制裁——西电公司（Western Electric）的安装人员 rushed 安装了电话打字机终端设备。这些设备被安置在由警方和电话公司规划的战略性地点。

在这个网络连接起来的33个城镇中，包括煤炭产区的斯克兰顿（Scranton）、林区的威廉斯波特（Williamsport）、石油产区的石油城（Oil City）和巴特勒（Butler），以及该州南部广阔起伏山区中的联合镇（Uniontown）。借助电话打字机，一条警务信息可以在不到五分钟的时间内广播到全州45,126平方英里的范围。

传输设备位于费城、匹兹堡和怀俄明（Wyoming）的三个区总部，以及哈里斯堡的中央总部。接收机位于这些区总部，以及33个城市、县侦探总部、州警察分局或营房，以及像费城这样的市级警察总部。在该市，有一个本地电话打字机系统连接着40个警察局。

从任何一个区总部通过类似打字机的仪器发送的信息，就像打印好的便条一样，被整个区域内的接收机接收。

一天晚上十点半左右，就在费城拥挤的南区所有孩子都上街回家睡觉后不久，两名男子走进了南第四街车库。其中一人拔出手枪，将车库服务员逼到墙边。另一人启动了一辆直列八缸轿车。又一分钟后，他们轰鸣着沿第四街驶去。

夜班服务员报警。他描述了两名抢劫者的特征。

十分钟后，在市政厅，一条信息通过本地电话打字机系统发出。它也通过覆盖费城区的州内系统发出，并传至哈里斯堡的总指挥部，在那里被转发至全州。这条信息被警方代码系统指定为 General 89 - Ph 18：

GENERAL 89 PH 18 - 3月12日
逮捕两名年轻白人男子 - 1号男子 28岁 5英尺8英寸 150磅 - 身材瘦削 戴浅色帽子 穿蓝色大衣 此人持有左轮手枪 - 2号男子 35岁 5英尺8英寸 185磅 - 穿浅色大衣 戴浅色软帽 面色红润 因今晚10:30在南第四街1822号的南第四街车库持枪抢劫及盗窃一辆胡普莫比尔（Hupmobile）直列八缸轿车而在费城第25警察辖区被通缉 - 黑色车身 绿色车轮 宾夕法尼亚州车牌号和发动机号不详 - 后续将有消息跟进

pages.en:
- 3 -

The message came tapping in over the receiving station in the State Police
Headquarters at Greensburg, Pa., in the far western section of the state.

The two hold-up men in their "high-powered sedan" took to the secluded roads
through mountain ranges, deep forests. The dark night protected them. One
would think they were easily escaping all possible capture. They probably
chuckled with such confidence themselves.

Over two and a half hours of steady, furious driving had taken them far from
the scene of their "job". They were wise, they thought. So many crooks, like
fools, hang around afterward. They would stop off in Greensburg for a cup of
coffee. A State Trooper on his motorcycle leisurely patrolled the main high-
way through Greensburg. Tucked in his pocket was a piece of paper carrying
the description of a green car - two men - one with a gun.

Ten minutes later this message came tapping in at City Hall, Philadelphia.

STATE POLICE AT GREENSBURG PA HAVE ARRESTED TWO MEN SENT OUT ON GENERAL 89 -
PH 18 AS WANTED IN THE 25TH POLICE DIST PHILA FOR LARCENY AND HOLDUP - PLEASE
ADVISE

Within three hours after "the job was pulled", just as long as it took the two
men to travel across the state, the arrest was made.

"I used to put all my faith in the night stick - the black jack - the gun",
said Chief Dispatcher Dougherty, a dyed-in-the-wool "cop" of 30 years service,
"Now I put all my faith in this - the telephone typewriter. One thing a
policeman needs to make a "catch" is information. Now every policeman in the
state can have all available information within a few minutes after commission
of a crime."
pages.zh:
- 3 -

信息滴答作响地传入位于该州远西部格林斯堡（Greensburg）的州警察总部接收站。

两名抢劫犯驾驶着他们的“大马力轿车”，取道穿越山脉和深林的偏僻道路。黑夜保护了他们。人们会认为他们轻易地逃脱了所有可能的抓捕。他们自己可能也因这种自信而窃喜。

经过两个半小时持续而疯狂的驾驶，他们已远离作案现场。他们自以为很聪明。许多蠢贼事后会在附近逗留。他们打算在格林斯堡停下来喝杯咖啡。一名州警骑着摩托车在穿过格林斯堡的主要公路上悠闲地巡逻。他的口袋里装着一张纸条，上面写着对一辆绿色汽车和两名男子——其中一人持有枪支——的描述。

十分钟后，这条信息滴答作响地传入费城市政厅。

宾夕法尼亚州格林斯堡州警察已逮捕两名男子 系因General 89 - PH 18通缉令所列 在费城第25警察辖区因盗窃和持枪抢劫被通缉者 - 请指示

在“作案”后三小时内，正好是这两人穿越全州所需的时间，逮捕行动完成。

“过去我把所有的信任都放在警棍、短棒和手枪上，”拥有30年资历、根深蒂固的老警察首席调度员多尔蒂说，“现在我把所有的信任都放在这个——电话打字机上。警察要‘抓人’需要的一样东西就是信息。现在，全州每名警察都能在犯罪发生后的几分钟内获得所有可用信息。”

KEY-TAPS THAT TRAP CRIMINALS
Telephone Typewriter Service Proves Invaluable
As Aid to Police.
Apr 14 1930

One night late last December a band of masked men robbed a grocery
store in a Western Pennsylvania town and made their escape. It was the old story -
defenseless storekeeper surprised at his work, sudden appearance of armed thugs,
crisp command to "Stick 'em up!" Then the hurried rifling of the till, the slam-
ming of sedan doors, the roar of a motor as the bandit car lurched through darkened
streets and broke for the open country. The "get-away" in the parlance of the under-
world.

But in this particular case, it was not to be the old story, after all.
A few days before, the Pennsylvania State Police had put in service a telephone
typewriter system linking some ninety-five cities, towns, villages and smaller po-
lice outposts scattered throughout the state into a far-flung mesh of wires; a trap
to catch just such enemies of law and order as were now making their dash for
liberty.

Ten minutes after the robbery was reported to the nearest troop bar-
racks of the state police, details of the affair had been tapped off on telephone
typewriter receiving machines in twenty-nine towns of Western Pennsylvania from
zone headquarters at Pittsburgh and orders given to watch every highway over which
the criminals might be expected to attempt to escape. To have sent this informa-
tion to the same towns under the old method of telegrams and telephone calls would
have required several hours, according to the state police sergeant who reported
the crime. As a matter of fact, any crime, committed anywhere in the commonwealth,
could have been broadcast as quickly, not alone to the police of a single zone, but

捕捉罪犯的按键敲击声
电话打字机服务证明对协助警方极具价值
1930年4月14日

去年十二月的一个深夜，一伙蒙面男子抢劫了宾夕法尼亚州西部一个城镇的一家杂货店并逃逸。这是个老套的故事——毫无防备的店主在工作中遭到突袭，武装暴徒突然出现，发出干脆的命令“举起手来！”接着是匆忙洗劫收银机，猛力关上车门，匪车在黑暗的街道上颠簸前行并冲向开阔乡村时发出的马达轰鸣声。用黑话来说，这就是“逃跑”（get-away）。

但在这一特定案例中，这终究不再是那个老套的故事。
几天前，宾夕法尼亚州警察启用了一套电话打字机系统，将散布在全州的约九十五个城市、城镇、村庄和小型警察哨所连接成一个广阔的电线网；这是一个陷阱，旨在捕捉那些正试图逃向自由的法治敌人。

抢劫案报告给最近的州警察营房十分钟后，有关此案的详细信息已通过电话打字机接收机从匹兹堡区总部敲发到宾夕法尼亚州西部的二十九个城镇，并下令监视罪犯可能试图逃跑的每一条公路。据报告此案的州警察警长称，若按旧有的电报和电话方式将这些信息发送到同样的城镇，则需要数小时。事实上，无论在联邦内的何处发生任何犯罪，都可以同样快速地进行广播，不仅是向单个区域的警察，而且

pages.en:
-2-
to every one of more than a hundred receiving machines connected with the system
and serving the entire state.
After being subjected to the rigorous test of day-by-day service in
New York City, in Boston, in St. Louis, in Kansas City and in Buffalo, the tele-
phone typewriter has proved its value to municipal police, as it has on a some-
what broader scale in Connecticut, where a network connecting a chain of cities
has been in successful operation for some time.
The installation of the system in Pennsylvania, however, approaches
the problem of the prevention of crime and the preservation of the peace as being
one of statewide interest, to be solved, not separately by the several communities
of a state, but by bringing about closer cooperation between them, on a state-
wide basis.

New Aspects of the Crime Problem

It is becoming increasingly evident that the crime problems of the
large city and those of the small and isolated community are really different
aspects of the same problem; that the interests of city and country are common
interests; that the city patrolman, pacing the pavement of his beat and swing-
ing his nightstick, and the state trooper, sitting astride his horse or motor-
cycle at some country crossroad, are public servants engaged in performing one
and the same duty.
Changed conditions have created new phases of the problem of protect-
ing society against its own lawless element. The automobile has proved a boon
to humanity, but it has also proved a potential menace to society's safety in
rural districts as well as in congested city streets. Hit-and-run drivers are among
the new school of criminals produced by the modern age, and they are found on
country lanes as well as on city boulevards. The automobile has proved, moreover,
pages.zh:
-2-
向与该系统相连并服务于全州的百余台接收机中的每一台。
在纽约市、波士顿、圣路易斯、堪萨斯城和布法罗经历了日复一日服务的严格测试后，电话打字机已证明其对市级警方的价值，正如它在康涅狄格州较大规模的应用中所证明的那样，那里连接一系列城市的网络已成功运行了一段时间。
然而，在宾夕法尼亚州安装该系统，是将预防犯罪和维护治安的问题视为一种全州性的利益，不是由州内的各个社区分别解决，而是通过在全州基础上促进它们之间更紧密的合作来解决。

犯罪问题的新层面

越来越明显的是，大城市的犯罪问题与小而孤立社区的犯罪问题实际上是同一问题的不同方面；城市和乡村的利益是共同利益；在城市街道上巡逻、挥舞警棍的城市巡警，与坐在马背或摩托车上守候在乡村十字路口的州警，都是履行同一职责的公仆。
变化的形势产生了保护社会免受其自身不法元素侵害的新阶段。汽车已被证明是人类的一大福音，但它也被证明是对农村地区和拥挤城市街道社会安全的潜在威胁。肇事逃逸司机是现代产生的新型罪犯之一，他们既出现在乡村小道上，也出现在城市大道上。此外，汽车已证明，

pages.en:
-3-

a potent instrument in the hands of those who commit the more deliberate crimes
of violence. Murder has become motorized and banditry thrives because escape
has been made easy by high-speed transportation facilities.

Time was when rural crime was largely confined to chicken-stealing
and similar minor offenses, conceived and executed by local residents. Crime in
the rural districts and small towns today is far more likely to bear the trade-
mark of some well organized band of experts in outlawry carefully engineered in
the urban underworld and carried out with the aid of all the instrumentalities
which a machine age has placed in the hands of the lawless as well as the law-
abiding. Crimes committed in the city, on the other hand, may be the work of
racketeers who, when the chase makes their accustomed haunts too uncomfortable,
betake themselves to some secluded farm selected in advance as a haven of refuge.

In short, the distinction between rural crime and urban crime is becoming cons-
tantly less definite. Crime has no geographical boundaries; crime prevention and
the preservation of the peace can have none. If crime is to be considered as a
problem of society as a whole and to be dealt with on a broad geographical basis,
it is obvious that there must be the closest possible co-operation between the
police authorities of the several communities concerned. It is just as obvious
that these police authorities, in order thus to co-operate with each other, must
be provided with the swiftest, simplest and surest facilities for communication
that it is possible to devise. That is why Pennsylvania, in searching for a com-
munication system that will make it possible for city police and state troopers
to work more closely together, has turned to the telephone typewriter.

How the System Operates

The telephone typewriter equipment employed in police work is essential-
ly similar to that used in brokerage houses, business concerns, commercial air
transport companies and press associations for the transmission of written mes-
pages.zh:
-3-

对于那些犯下更为蓄意的暴力罪行的人来说，这是一种强有力的工具。谋杀已变得机动化，而由于高速交通工具使得逃逸变得容易，匪盗活动也日益猖獗。

曾几何时，乡村犯罪主要局限于偷鸡之类的轻微罪行，由当地居民策划并实施。如今，乡村地区和小城镇的犯罪更有可能带有某些组织严密的职业犯罪团伙的印记，这些团伙在城市地下世界中精心策划，并利用机器时代提供给违法者以及守法者的各种手段来实施犯罪。另一方面，在城市中实施的犯罪可能是勒索敲诈者的手笔，当追捕使得他们惯常的藏身之处变得过于危险时，他们便逃往预先选定的偏僻农场作为避难所。

简而言之，乡村犯罪与城市犯罪之间的区别正变得愈发模糊。犯罪没有地理界限；预防犯罪和维护治安也不应有界限。如果将犯罪视为整个社会的问题，并在广阔的地理基础上加以处理，那么显然，相关各社区的警察当局之间必须进行尽可能密切的合作。同样显而易见的是，这些警察当局为了彼此合作，必须配备所能设计出的最迅速、最简便且最可靠的通信设施。这就是为什么宾夕法尼亚州在寻找一种能使城市警察和州警更紧密合作的通信系统时，转向了电话打字机。

系统如何运作

警务工作中使用的电话打字机设备，本质上与经纪行、商业公司、商业航空运输公司和新闻社用于传输书面信

pages.en:
-4-
sages. Each complete installation consists of at least one sending and receiving
machine and one or more receiving-only machines. By means of electrically con-
trolled mechanisms which it is not necessary to describe in the present article,
whatever is written on a sending and receiving machine can be instantly received
and recorded in typewritten form on any or all machines connected with the circuit.
The operator simply types his message on a keyboard similar to that of a standard
typewriter and what he writes is automatically recorded on the receiving machines,
whether there is anyone there to receive it or not. A permanent record is made by
both the transmitting and receiving machines, and extra carbon copies may be made
if desired.

The system recently installed by the Pennsylvania state police consists
of more than 3,400 miles of telephone circuits, connecting Central Headquarters at
Harrisburg with Zone Headquarters at Philadelphia, Pittsburgh and Wyoming. Each
of these, in turn, is connected with the various local barracks or stations of
which it forms the central point. The Central Headquarters is equipped with one
regular and one emergency machine capable of both sending and receiving and a
radial telephone typewriter switchboard with a capacity of twenty-four lines. Each
Zone Headquarters is similarly equipped, and has also one machine for receiving
only. Central Headquarters has three receiving-only instruments. All of the rest
of the instruments throughout the s' te are of the receiving-only type. In all
cases the receiving machines are equipped to take a page of paper eight and one-
half inches wide, which may be inserted page by page or fed into the machine from
a roll.

Ten channels spread out fan-wise from Harrisburg to various parts of
the state. These channels may be used singly or simultaneously. Branch circuits
connect each of the Zone Headquarters with all of the police receiving stations in
its district or zone. Over the channels between Central Headquarters and the res-
pages.zh:
-4-

息的设备相似。每套完整的装置至少包括一台收发机和一台或多台仅接收机。通过无需在本文中详述的电气控制机制，在收发机上输入的任何内容都可以立即以打字形式在任何或所有连接到该线路的机器上接收并记录。操作员只需在类似于标准打字机的键盘上键入信息，无论是否有人在场接收，他所输入的内容都会自动记录在接收机上。发送机和接收机都会生成永久记录，如果需要，还可以制作额外的复写副本。

宾夕法尼亚州警察最近安装的系统由超过 3,400 英里的电话线路组成，将位于哈里斯堡（Harrisburg）的中央总部与位于费城（Philadelphia）、匹兹堡（Pittsburgh）和怀俄明（Wyoming）的区域总部连接起来。这些区域总部中的每一个又与其作为中心点的各个地方营房或站点相连。中央总部配备了一台常规和一台应急收发机，以及一个容量为二十四线的径向电话打字机交换机。每个区域总部也配备了类似的设备，并另有一台仅接收机。中央总部有三台仅接收仪器。全州其余的所有仪器均为仅接收类型。在所有情况下，接收机都配置为使用八又二分之一英寸宽的纸张，可以逐页插入，也可以从卷筒送入机器。

十条信道像扇面一样从哈里斯堡辐射到该州的各个地区。这些信道可以单独使用，也可以同时使用。分支线路将每个区域总部与其辖区或区域内的所有警察接收站连接起来。在中央总部与各

pages.en:
-5-
pective Zone Headquarters it is possible to carry on two-way simultaneous
(duplex) service.

In actual operation, the system works in this way: the local or
state police official in charge of the investigation of a crime telephones his
report to the nearest Zone Headquarters, which immediately puts the necessary
information on the wire for transmission to all stations of its own zone and also
to Central Headquarters, where it may be retransmitted, if desired, to any or all
of the other zones of the state. Broadcasting a piece of important police infor-
mation may thus be accomplished in a few minutes, the message appearing simulta-
neously on 102 receiving machines scattered from one end of the state to the
other.

The Pennsylvania network is a Bell System installation, the circuits
being provided and the machines installed by the Bell Telephone Company of Penn-
sylvania.

Connecticut's City-Linking Circuit

Next to that of Pennsylvania, the most extensive telephone typewriter
system now in operation, in point of territory covered, is that used by the mu-
nicipal police departments in certain cities in Connecticut. Unlike that of
Pennsylvania, this network is not state-operated, but its coverage is now almost
state-wide. The system was put in operation by mutual agreement on the part of
the cities served, the machines and circuits being leased through the Southern
New England Telephone Company. The cities now connected with the circuit are
Hartford, New Britain, Bristol, Waterbury, Naugatuck, Middletown, Meridian, Derby
(which also serves Shelton and Ansonia by telephone), Danbury, Willimantic, New
London, Bridgeport, Stamford and Norwalk. In addition to the Hartford police
installation, the latter city has also one in the office of the Connecticut Motor
pages.zh:
-5-

相应区域总部之间的信道上，可以进行双向同时（双工）服务。

在实际操作中，该系统的工作方式如下：负责调查犯罪的地方或州警察官员通过电话向最近的区域总部报告，该总部立即将必要信息上线，传输至其所在区域的所有站点，同时也传至中央总部，在那里可以根据需要重新传输至该州任何其他或所有区域。因此，广播一条重要的警务信息可以在几分钟内完成，信息会同时出现在遍布全州两端的 102 台接收机上。

宾夕法尼亚网络是贝尔系统（Bell System）的安装项目，线路由宾夕法尼亚贝尔电话公司提供，机器也由该公司安装。

康涅狄格州的城市互联线路

就覆盖地域而言，仅次于宾夕法尼亚州、目前运行范围最广的电话打字机系统，是康涅狄格州某些城市的市政警察部门所使用的系统。与宾夕法尼亚州不同，该网络并非由州政府运营，但其覆盖范围现在几乎遍及全州。该系统是根据所服务城市之间的相互协议投入运行的，机器和线路通过新英格兰南部电话公司（Southern New England Telephone Company）租赁。目前接入该线路的城市包括哈特福德（Hartford）、新不列颠（New Britain）、布里斯托尔（Bristol）、沃特伯里（Waterbury）、诺加塔克（Naugatuck）、米德尔敦（Middletown）、梅里登（Meridian）、德比（Derby，同时也通过电话服务于谢尔顿 Shelton 和安索尼亚 Ansonia）、丹伯里（Danbury）、威利曼蒂克（Willimantic）、新伦敦（New London）、布里奇波特（Bridgeport）、斯坦福德（Stamford）和诺沃克（Norwalk）。除了哈特福德警察局的装置外，该市还在康涅狄格州机动车

Vehicle Commission. The police department of Springfield, Mass., is also
connected with the system. The network is equipped for two-way transmission
between all stations, so that any station can communicate with any other station
on the circuit.
The connection with the state motor vehicle registration offices has been
of great value in obtaining prompt information as the ownership of cars identified
by number only. One of the outstanding advantages of such a network as that of
Connecticut or Pennsylvania is its use in connection with the recovery of stolen
automobiles. An illustration of the effectiveness of the telephone typewriter for
this purpose is a recent case in Connecticut. On January 3, at 12:45 p.m., a
Norwalk resident reported to the police of that city that she had just seen a man,
whom she described, get into her roadster, which had been left standing in front
of her home, and drive off toward Stamford. The Norwalk police immediately sent
word of the theft to Stamford and other neighboring cities by telephone typewriter
and at 1:10 p.m. the Stamford police reported, also by telephone typewriter, that
they had halted the car and placed the driver and another man under arrest.
Incidentally, a strong point in favor of the telephone typewriter as a
means of communication between police departments, particularly in cases of this
kind, is its usefulness in giving prompt notice of arrests and the recovery of
property reported stolen. This enables the police in all cities that have re-
ceived the original notification of the crime to mark the case off their records
and stop working on it. Besides the obvious advantage of saving the police an
enormous amount of needless effort, this prompt reporting of recovery of stolen
cars frequently forestalls a situation which, though amusing to everybody except
the parties directly concerned, is to the latter a cause of unmitigated annoyance.
This is the case of the car owner whose machine has been stolen and recovered, but
who is haled to court in some strange town because the recovery has not been properly

辆委员会的办公室设有另一套装置。马萨诸塞州斯普林菲尔德（Springfield, Mass.）的警察局也接入了该系统。该网络配备了所有站点之间的双向传输功能，因此任何站点都可以与线路上的任何其他站点通信。

与州机动车注册办公室的连接在获取仅凭号码识别的车辆所有权信息方面具有极大价值。康涅狄格州或宾夕法尼亚州这类网络的一个突出优势是其在追回被盗汽车方面的应用。电话打字机在此目的上的有效性的一个例证是康涅狄格州最近发生的一起案件。1 月 3 日下午 12:45，一名诺沃克居民向该市警察报告称，她刚刚看到一名男子（她描述了其特征）进入停在她家门前的敞篷跑车，并向斯坦福德方向驶离。诺沃克警方立即通过电话打字机向斯坦福德和其他邻近城市发送了盗窃消息，下午 1:10，斯坦福德警方也通过电话打字机报告称，他们已拦下该车，并将司机和另一名男子逮捕。

顺便提一下，电话打字机作为警察部门之间的一种通信手段，特别是在此类案件中，其一大优点是能够及时通报逮捕情况和追回报失财产的情况。这使得所有收到原始犯罪通知的城市的警察都能将该案从记录中注销并停止相关工作。除了明显节省警察大量不必要的精力这一优势外，这种对追回被盗汽车的及时报告经常能避免一种虽然让除直接当事人外的所有人觉得好笑，但对当事人来说却是纯粹烦恼的局面。这种情况就是车主的车被盗后又找回，但由于找回情况未适当

Municipal Police Systems

The use of the telephone typewriter for municipal police purposes has long since passed the experimental stage. New York City's system was put in service in the early spring of 1928 and has emphatically proved its value as a means of communication between General Headquarters and the widely scattered borough headquarters and precincts. Messages are sent from General Headquarters direct to the precincts in the Borough of Manhattan and through the borough headquarters in the remaining four boroughs. Seven machines at General Headquarters form a center of more than a hundred machines in the entire system. A switchboard similar to that described in connection with the Pennsylvania system enables General Headquarters to transmit to any borough separately, or to all five simultaneously. The system was developed as a result of joint studies made by the New York Telephone Company, which made the installation and supplies the circuits.

Other large cities which have Bell System telephone typewriter services include Boston, with apparatus at headquarters and in twenty-one division stations; Buffalo and Pittsburgh, each with twenty machines; St. Louis, with nineteen; Kansas City with nine, and Worcester with five. In commenting on the success of the service in their respective cities, police officials have frequently expressed the hope that similar systems might be installed in nearby cities and suburban districts, in order that there might be closer co-operation in police activities between the latter and the larger cities around which they center. A step in this direction has already been made in the Boston area, as telephone typewriter circuits now connect the municipal police system with headquarters in Quincy, Brookline, Cambridge, Arlington, Chelsea, Everett, Malden, Medford, Melrose and Somerville.

A somewhat more extensive suburban system is being installed in Westchester County, New York, an urban, suburban and rural section lying immediately north of the

向后者所在城市的警察报告，导致车主在某个陌生城镇被传唤出庭。

市政警察系统

电话打字机用于市政警务早已过了实验阶段。纽约市的系统于 1928 年早春投入使用，并有力地证明了其作为总指挥部与分布广泛的各区总部及分局之间通信手段的价值。信息从总指挥部直接发送至曼哈顿区（Manhattan）的各分局，并通过其余四个区的区总部发送。总指挥部的七台机器构成了整个系统中一百多台机器的中心。一个类似于宾夕法尼亚系统中描述的交换机使总指挥部能够单独向任何一个区传输，或同时向所有五个区传输。该系统的开发是纽约电话公司（负责安装并提供线路）共同研究的结果。

其他拥有贝尔系统电话打字机服务的大城市包括波士顿，其总部和二十一个分局均配有设备；布法罗（Buffalo）和匹兹堡，各有二十台机器；圣路易斯（St. Louis），有十九台；堪萨斯城（Kansas City），有九台；伍斯特（Worcester），有五台。在评论各自城市服务的成功时，警察官员经常表示希望附近城市和郊区也能安装类似系统，以便后者与以其为中心的大城市之间在警务活动上进行更密切的合作。波士顿地区已经朝这个方向迈出了一步，因为电话打字机线路现在将市政警察系统与昆西（Quincy）、布鲁克莱恩（Brookline）、剑桥（Cambridge）、阿灵顿（Arlington）、切尔西（Chelsea）、埃弗里特（Everett）、马尔登（Malden）、梅德福（Medford）、梅尔罗斯（Melrose）和萨默维尔（Somerville）的总部连接起来。

纽约州威彻斯特郡（Westchester County）正在安装一个规模稍大的郊区系统，该地区是一个位于纽约大都会区正北部的城市、郊区和农村混合区域。该县三十三个市、镇和乡警察部门中的二十九个已安排通过电话打字机线路进行互通。县警长办公室和县公园大道委员会警察局的官员也接入了该系统。人们正在考虑将该系统与康涅狄格州以及纽约市警察局的系统连接起来。

其他州和市政警察部门正在考虑安装电话打字机系统，或正处于规划此类网络投入使用的细节过程中。

科学赋予了司法逃犯高速汽车甚至飞机的优势；用机枪武装了凶手；通过提供硝化甘油使窃贼的效率加倍。但科学也将现代通信手段交到了社会手中，用以对抗这些犯罪工具。在电报和电话之外，电话打字机作为一种维护法律和秩序的工具被加入其中。月复一月，年复一年，这些警察的机械仆从加速传递着它们断断续续的警告、求助信号和合作承诺。日复一日，这些近乎神奇的机器，由远在数百英里外的无形手指操控，敲打出至关重要的信息，这不仅对警察，而且对整个公众都至关重要。连接这些计时机器的庞大网络的存在本身就是一种制约力量，它带来了希望，即美国可能成为一个对每个人——除了罪犯——更安全的地方。

New York metropolitan area. Twenty-nine of the thirty-three city, village and
town police departments of the county have arranged for intercommunication by
means of a telephone typewriter circuit. The officers of the sheriff of the
county and of the police department of the County Parkway Commission are also con-
nected with this system. Consideration is being given to the idea of connecting
this system with those of Connecticut and the New York City Police Department.

Other state and municipal police departments have the installation of
telephone typewriter systems under consideration or are now in the process of plan-
ning the details of putting such networks into service.

Science has given the fugitive from justice the advantage of the high-
speed automobile and even of the airplane; has armed the murderer with the machine
gun; has made the cracksman doubly efficient by providing him with nitroglycerine.
But science has also placed in the hands of society modern means of communication
with which to combat these tools of crime. To the telegraph and the telephone, the
telephone typewriter has been added as an instrumentality of law and order. Month
by month and year by year, these mechanical servants of the police are speeding their
staccato warnings, calls for help and pledges of co-operation. Day by day these
almost magical machines, guided by unseen fingers that may be hundreds of miles
away, are tapping out messages of vital importance, not alone to the police, but to
the public as a whole. The very existence of the far-flung networks which connect
these clocking machines is a restraining force that brings the hope that America
may become a safer place for everybody - except criminals.
